actors.role: sets priorities, reallocates budget, adjudicates irreversible scope decisions

actors.label: Astra
actors.role: global coordinator, research-map owner, portfolio manager

actors.label: Formulation lead
actors.role: owns class taxonomy and conjecture schemas

actors.label: Literature lead
actors.role: owns theorem ledger and citation verification

actors.label: Numerics lead

actors.label: Remote DSH DeepSeek Flash pool
actors.role: cheap parallel drafting, retrieval, coding, and replication

assignments.acceptance: File exists; parses; exactly the 4 class ids above; each has hypotheses, exclusions, conclusion_type, and one positive + one negative test case; provenance marks it reconstructed-from-handoff (unverified) until reviewers accept.
assignments.expected_information_gain: Restores the F0 artifact that the map previously marked done without evidence; F1/F2/L0 all depend on it.
assignments.falsifier: A class in the file cannot be distinguished from another on a concrete test case, or a class lacks an explicit exclusion list.
assignments.stop_rule: Stop when the 4 classes have disjoint hypotheses and reviewers 16/17 return verdicts.

assignments.acceptance: Schema declares, as separate machine-readable fields: exact quantifiers; topology (globally hyperbolic AF 3+1, I+/I-/i0); weighted data class with named s, delta; genericity (open dense, named topology); visibility definition at I+; conclusion_type=weak_cosmic_censorship; explicit non-goals.
assignments.expected_information_gain: Fixes the class boundary that every downstream theorem and numerical test binds to.
assignments.falsifier: Two competent readers disagree whether a given asymptotically flat vacuum spacetime satisfies the schema; or the conclusion type entails SCC rather than WCC.
assignments.stop_rule: Stop at a frozen schema revision with reviewer verdicts; freeze the sha256 in the map.

assignments.acceptance: Two clearly separated sections (C2, C0), each with its own hypotheses, metric regularity, conclusion_type and known obstruction; a machine-checkable lint proves no merged class string.
assignments.expected_information_gain: Prevents the single most likely scope error in the portfolio: treating low-regularity SCC as C2 SCC.
assignments.falsifier: The file uses 'C0 or C2' anywhere, or one regularity class inherits the other's conclusion type.
assignments.stop_rule: Stop when F2a and F2b each have an independent reviewer (18) and the lint passes.

assignments.acceptance: >=15 rows; each row: source (authors, year, title, DOI/arXiv), theorem as quoted, assumptions, class_id, what it does NOT prove, verification_status in {unverified, abstract-read, full-text, page-checked}, falsifier.
assignments.expected_information_gain: Turns the literature draft into a primary-source ledger and exposes which classes are actually covered.
assignments.falsifier: A ledger row cites a source that cannot be located, or states a theorem more strongly than the source does.
assignments.stop_rule: Stop when every row has a locator and the class column is non-empty; unresolved citations stay marked unresolved.

assignments.acceptance: One row per ledger source with locator, resolver result, exact theorem number/page, class mapping, verdict, and reviewer.
assignments.expected_information_gain: Citation support is a first-class metric; this is the gate that stops citation inflation.
assignments.falsifier: A DOI/arXiv id resolves to a different paper, or the cited theorem is in a different regularity class than mapped.
assignments.stop_rule: Stop when every L0 row has an audit row; mark unresolved rather than guessing.

assignments.acceptance: Runs headless; compares against a closed-form flat-space scalar-wave solution; reports measured order; self-test fails closed; N1 lock guard present.
assignments.expected_information_gain: Calibrates the code path and the convergence protocol before any self-gravitating run; the cheap part of the critical path.
assignments.falsifier: Measured convergence order is below the declared order minus tolerance, or the exact-solution residual does not shrink with resolution.
assignments.stop_rule: Stop when worker 12's implementation and worker 13's independent replication agree on measured order within tolerance.

assignments.acceptance: Precise unblock checklist: G-FORM pass, G-AUDIT pass, N0 order measured + replicated, protocol reviewed; plus a statement that no self-gravitating code has been written.
assignments.expected_information_gain: Makes the lock auditable instead of an instruction agents can ignore.
assignments.falsifier: The file proposes a self-gravity run, or claims a release condition that a required gate does not actually satisfy.
assignments.stop_rule: Stop when the checklist maps 1:1 to map gates and the guard test enforces it.

assignments.acceptance: Per-task-type verifier definitions (schema, literature, numerics, formal); hard-failure list; no universal scalar score; every acceptance test machine-checkable or reviewer-adjudicated with named evidence.
assignments.expected_information_gain: Restores the A0 artifact the map marked done without evidence; gates depend on it.
assignments.falsifier: The rubric contains a universal scalar score, or a task type whose verifier is fluency review.
assignments.stop_rule: Stop when reviewers 17/19 accept and the map hashes the frozen file.

assignments.acceptance: For each of F0,F1,F2a,F2b,L0: two reviewers, independent verdicts with artifact sha256, class-leakage check, conclusion-inflation check, hard-failure list, score 0-5.
assignments.expected_information_gain: This is the gate that decides whether formulation output may be promoted; it is the highest-value review in the run.
assignments.falsifier: A review verdict exists without a cited artifact sha256, or two 'independent' reviews are the same text.
assignments.stop_rule: Stop when each target has 2 verdicts or is explicitly marked inconclusive.

assignments.acceptance: 4 arms (strong model, self-consistency, independent cheap agents, cheap+coordinator) with matched token and wall-clock budgets, pre-registered metrics (accepted-claim rate, hard-failure rate, citation support, duplication, reviewer agreement, novel accepted coverage, cost/accepted claim, per-class coverage), and a null baseline.
assignments.expected_information_gain: Prevents a swarm-advantage claim with no matched-budget control.
assignments.falsifier: Arms are not matched on tokens and wall-clock, or the primary metric is a universal scalar score.
assignments.stop_rule: Design only this run; execution waits for G-FORM and G-AUDIT.

assignments.acceptance: Main author of the taxonomy file; 4 classes; disjointness table.
assignments.expected_information_gain: Foundation artifact.
assignments.falsifier: Class overlap on a test case.
assignments.stop_rule: Submit artifact event with sha256.

assignments.acceptance: >=8 positive and >=8 negative cases covering the 4 classes; each case names the class and the decisive hypothesis.
assignments.expected_information_gain: Machine-checkable class separation.
assignments.falsifier: A case cannot be classified under exactly one class.
assignments.stop_rule: Submit with sha256; flag ambiguous cases as open.

assignments.acceptance: Main author; exact quantifiers, topology, weighted data class, genericity, I+, visibility, conclusion_type.
assignments.expected_information_gain: Core schema.
assignments.falsifier: Ambiguous quantifier/topology field.
assignments.stop_rule: Submit draft + list of fields you could not pin down.

assignments.acceptance: >=10 ambiguity tests: spacetime description + does it satisfy F1? + which field decides.
assignments.expected_information_gain: Falsifier suite for F1.
assignments.falsifier: A test that no schema field can decide.
assignments.stop_rule: Submit with sha256.

assignments.acceptance: C2-only schema: metric regularity C2, conclusion_type for SCC at C2, known obstructions, non-goals.
assignments.expected_information_gain: Separates the strongest SCC class.
assignments.falsifier: C2 conclusion reused for C0 data.
assignments.stop_rule: Submit with sha256.

assignments.acceptance: C0-only schema: metric regularity C0, what fails at C0, weaker conclusion_type, explicit non-goals, leakage test vs C2.
assignments.expected_information_gain: Separates the low-regularity SCC class.
assignments.falsifier: C0 schema assumes C2 control or inherits the C2 conclusion.
assignments.stop_rule: Submit with sha256.

assignments.acceptance: Skeleton schema + >=10 filled rows with locators and explicit non-claims.
assignments.expected_information_gain: Ledger skeleton.
assignments.falsifier: A row without a locator.
assignments.stop_rule: Submit with sha256; unresolved stays unresolved.

assignments.acceptance: Verify WCC-side sources: Penrose 1969; Christodoulou 1999; Dafermos-Rodnianski; Ringstrom; and 2+ more. Locator + exact theorem + class mapping + verdict.
assignments.expected_information_gain: Primary-source support for WCC.
assignments.falsifier: DOI resolves to a different work.
assignments.stop_rule: Fetch each locator; record HTTP/DOI result; mark failures.

assignments.acceptance: Verify SCC-side sources: Dafermos; Luk-Oh; Choptuik; Eardley-Gundlach; Gundlach-Martin-Garcia; and 2+ more, with exact theorem numbers and class mapping.
assignments.expected_information_gain: Primary-source support for SCC classes.
assignments.falsifier: Theorem quoted in the wrong regularity class.
assignments.stop_rule: Record resolver results; unresolved list is a valid output.

assignments.acceptance: Matrix source x class with covered/partial/none and the exact theorem that covers it.
assignments.expected_information_gain: Shows where the portfolio is actually open.
assignments.falsifier: A class claimed covered with no source that states its conclusion type.
assignments.stop_rule: Submit with sha256.

assignments.acceptance: >=6 known solutions/spacetimes that show genericity or hypothesis necessity; each with source, which hypothesis it violates, which class it bounds.
assignments.expected_information_gain: Bounds what each class can claim.
assignments.falsifier: A 'counterexample' that violates a hypothesis excluded by the class schema.
assignments.stop_rule: Submit with sha256.

assignments.acceptance: Headless test: closed-form solution, 3+ resolutions, measured order, asserts order >= declared - tol, exit code reflects pass/fail.
assignments.expected_information_gain: Code calibration.
assignments.falsifier: No measured convergence order.
assignments.stop_rule: Run it; submit stdout + sha256.

assignments.acceptance: Independent scheme (different stencil/method) reproducing the same measured order; documents differences from worker 12.
assignments.expected_information_gain: Independent numerical replication.
assignments.falsifier: Replication shares the same discretization bug as worker 12.
assignments.stop_rule: Submit both orders; disagreement is a finding.

assignments.acceptance: Self-convergence (Richardson), exact-solution residual, constraint/invariant diagnostics, failure criteria, resolution ladder, reporting table.
assignments.expected_information_gain: Makes convergence auditable before self-gravity.
assignments.falsifier: Protocol cannot detect a wrong order.
assignments.stop_rule: Submit with sha256.

assignments.acceptance: Test fails if numerics/spherical_solver/ exists or if any N1+ artifact is present while numerics_lock.state==locked; reads the map file.
assignments.expected_information_gain: Machine-enforces the controller lock.
assignments.falsifier: Guard passes while a self-gravity artifact exists.
assignments.stop_rule: Run the guard; submit stdout + sha256.

assignments.acceptance: Main author: per-task-type verifiers, hard failures, evidence requirements, no universal scalar score.
assignments.expected_information_gain: Evaluation gate artifact.
assignments.falsifier: Any universal scalar score.
assignments.stop_rule: Submit with sha256.

assignments.acceptance: Independent review of F0 and F1: class leakage, conclusion inflation, ambiguity; verdict + score + hard failures + cited sha256.
assignments.expected_information_gain: Second-reviewer independence.
assignments.falsifier: Verdict without artifact sha256.
assignments.stop_rule: Submit one review event per target.

assignments.acceptance: Adversarial review of F2a/F2b: hunt 'C0 or C2' leakage, conclusion inheritance; verdict + score + cited sha256.
assignments.expected_information_gain: Protects the most error-prone class split.
assignments.falsifier: C0 and C2 verdicts share reasoning or conclusion type.
assignments.stop_rule: Two separate verdicts, one per regularity.

assignments.acceptance: Independently re-fetch >=3 random ledger rows; report resolver result vs row claim; verdict.
assignments.expected_information_gain: Detects citation fabrication.
assignments.falsifier: Spot-checked row has a fabricated locator.
assignments.stop_rule: Submit verdict with the exact fetched locators.

assignments.acceptance: Harness enforces matched token+wall-clock budgets, logs per-arm metrics, runs on synthetic data end-to-end.
assignments.expected_information_gain: Makes the later ablation claim honest.
assignments.falsifier: Harness compares arms at unequal token budget.
assignments.stop_rule: Dry-run only; no model calls.

assignments.falsifier: Gate accepts any mutant fixture, or rejects a canonical schema for a rule which a domain reviewer shows is a legitimate formulation -> gate invalid, rejected at review.
assignments.stop_rule: 4.0 agent-hours or when the canonical schema hash appears and one gate run is recorded, whichever is first.

assignments.falsifier: Two independent implementations agree on a mutant that is in fact leaky (both false-negative) -> differential testing insufficient for that leak class; report the leak class and a targeted rule proposal.
assignments.stop_rule: 3.0 agent-hours or when the canonical schema hash appears and one gate run is recorded, whichever is first.

assignments.falsifier: A rephrased fixture carrying a real leak passes and is reported as caught -> corpus invalid. A rephrased leak that passes and is honestly reported as a blind spot is a valid finding.
assignments.stop_rule: 3.0 agent-hours or when the canonical schema hash appears and one gate run is recorded, whichever is first.

assignments.falsifier: If a placement exists in which the C2 schema's conclusion is satisfied by a C0-only extension class (or vice versa), separation fails; report exact path and repair.
assignments.stop_rule: 3.0 agent-hours or when the canonical schema hash appears and one gate run is recorded, whichever is first.

assignments.falsifier: If two notions are shown equivalent under stated hypotheses, the rule 'genericity notion is part of the class' is falsified for that pair; report as a direction update, do not hide it.
assignments.stop_rule: 3.0 agent-hours or when the canonical schema hash appears and one gate run is recorded, whichever is first.

assignments.falsifier: If the extracted negation of a canonical schema is satisfiable by a trivial witness (e.g. 'no data exist'), the schema is vacuous; report the path.
assignments.stop_rule: 2.0 agent-hours or when the canonical schema hash appears and one gate run is recorded, whichever is first.

assignments.acceptance: C2-only schema at the canonical path; exact quantifiers, topology, metric regularity C2, genericity, I+, visibility-as-inextendibility, conclusion_type; sha256 in the artifact event.
assignments.expected_information_gain: Closes the orphaned F2a slot; F2 split is on the G-FORM critical path.
assignments.falsifier: Any field that lets a C0 datum satisfy this C2 schema, or a conclusion_type shared with the C0 schema.
assignments.stop_rule: Draft + self-check, or 2 agent-hours, whichever first; emit artifact and blocker events.

assignments.acceptance: Patch + >=6 labeled fixtures (done+missing artifact, done+no evidence, gate pass without evidence, lock violation, clean) with expected outcomes; runs as a test; no direct edit to research_map/*.py.
assignments.expected_information_gain: Removes the false-VALID failure mode permanently and turns it into a regression test.
assignments.falsifier: A synthetic map with a done node and missing artifact still prints VALID after the patch.
assignments.stop_rule: One integration attempt staged under artifacts/audit/; Astra integrates after audit-lead review.

assignments.acceptance: Aggregator that references schemas/af_scc_c2_vacuum.yaml and schemas/af_scc_c0_vacuum.yaml without merging them, plus a leakage lint consuming worker-06 rules; >=8 fixtures with expected verdicts.
assignments.expected_information_gain: Turns the F2 split into a machine-checkable artifact instead of two documents that could drift together.
assignments.falsifier: The aggregator file asserts a merged C0/C2 class, or a checker fixture labeled NEG passes.
assignments.stop_rule: Integrate after workers 06/08 publish their files; if they are late, ship the lint + fixtures against the taxonomy and emit a blocker.

assignments.acceptance: Checklist maps 1:1 to G-FORM/G-AUDIT + N0 measured order + replication; states no self-gravitating code exists.
assignments.expected_information_gain: Machine-checkable lock contract instead of an instruction.
assignments.falsifier: The contract proposes a self-gravity run or an unblock condition with no matching map gate.
assignments.stop_rule: Submit artifact + sha256; do not touch N1 status.

assignments.acceptance: Root cause for cnfem (order ~0, drift 1e1) with a minimal reproduction; fix or exclusion justified at implementation level; invariant check made scheme-appropriate or relabelled; clean re-run JSON with hashes.
assignments.expected_information_gain: Either a correct FEM replication (strengthening N0) or a documented harness defect; both are gate-relevant.
assignments.falsifier: Triage closes cnfem by deleting it, or the invariant gate is relaxed until cnfem passes.
assignments.stop_rule: Stop at root cause + clean re-run, or 3 agent-hours, whichever first; report blocker rather than deleting the scheme.

assignments.acceptance: Review of the energy-drift threshold used by the candidate and of the scheme-dependence finding; states what the protocol must require from an independent scheme (scheme-appropriate functional, order fit method, uncertainty).
assignments.expected_information_gain: Prevents replication from being judged by a functional that only the reference scheme can satisfy.
assignments.falsifier: A non-leapfrog scheme passes the leapfrog-functional gate on the same configuration.
assignments.stop_rule: Submit review with hashes; do not edit other workers' artifacts.

assignments.acceptance: Integrate workers 13/14 reports; propose G-NUM verdict to Astra with artifact hashes; also re-check the stale binding_status PROVISIONAL now that research_map/formulation_taxonomy.yaml exists on disk.
assignments.expected_information_gain: Single adjudicated numerics verdict instead of three overlapping reports.
assignments.falsifier: Proposal asks for G-NUM pass while the replication artifact is unclean.
assignments.stop_rule: Propose or hold; do not self-pass the gate. N1 stays queued.
